title.zh: 刑事事项互助（大韩民国）命令 2026
title.en: Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters (Republic of Korea) Order 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters (Republic of Korea) Order 2026 and comes into operation on 7 June 2026.

heading.en: Declaration of Republic of Korea as prescribed foreign country

text.en: 2. The Republic of Korea is declared as a prescribed foreign country for the purposes of Part 3 of the Act.
